data.name: ICMLA 2014 Accepted Papers Data Set
data.abstract: This data set compromises the metadata for the 2014 ICMLA conference's accepted papers, including ID, paper titles, author's keywords, abstracts and sessions in which they were exposed.

additional_info.summary: CSV format where each row is a paper and each column an attribute.
additional_info.variable_info:
Paper_Id: Number; identifier of the paper
Paper_Title: Free text; title of the paper 
Author_Keywords: Free text; author-generated keywords 
Abstract: Free text; paper abstracts
Session: Categorical; conference organizer's-selected, conference session in which the paper was presented
